root.Action: Fresh connected Survival player receives the native tick advancement.

iron_has_a_darker_side.Action: Pick up an iron ingot and synchronize the native inventory screen.

recipes/unlock.Action: The same real iron pickup unlocks the mod's recipes.

rusty_business.Action: Drop a nail into water and wait for the complete configured rust duration.

rusty_hook.Action: Drop fishing rods into water, allow native salvage rolls, and pick up a recovered hook.

infected.Action: Actual rusty zombie melee injury during the native glove-contact test.

glove_protection.Action: Equip gloves by right-clicking and withstand real rusty zombie melee attacks until one exposure is prevented.

shield_protection.Action: Raise a Tetanus Protection shield and block an actual enchanted zombie melee attack.

tetanized_mob.Action: Use Rust on an iron golem until a real conversion roll succeeds.

rusty_guardian.Action: The same successful, causal iron-golem conversion awards its specific advancement.

strange_meat.Action: Kill an egg-spawned Tetanized cow with a real player attack and pick up its infected meat.

clean_bill_of_health.Action: Apply a veterinary kit to a second egg-spawned Tetanized cow.

nice_one.Action: Kill an egg-spawned Tetanized Wither with a Creative-prepared test sword using the native attack method.

clinic.Action: Place a two-block Medicine Cabinet through the Survival block-item interaction.

trap_reset.Action: A cow walks into a placed trap; use its reset tool through the native block interaction.

rust_arrows.Action: Take a real 64-arrow/Rust smithing result through the native output slot.

medic.Action: Open a medic's actual merchant menu, supply its generated barter inputs, and take its output.

supply_run.Action: Sneak-interact with that medic holding its requested daily supply delivery.

spear.Action: Right-click a spear at a live indexed cow and land its actual raycast thrust.

why_did_i_eat_that.Action: Eat raw infected meat using the real item-use timer.

rabies.Action: Eat raw Rabid Meat using the real item-use timer.

rabies_cured.Action: Drink Rabies Cure after the raw-meat infection.

lockjaw_sonata.Action: Drink a Lockjaw Sonata potion using the real item-use timer.

antitoxin.Action: Drink antitoxin while Tetanus and Lockjaw are active.

vaccinated.Action: Drink a vaccine using the real item-use timer.

beacon_placed.Action: Place the Tetanized Beacon with its BlockItem.

beacon_full.Action: Build its complete rusty-iron pyramid, pay Netherite in the native menu, and wait for real beacon ticks.

why_did_i_do_that.Action: Throw a rusty nail upward and catch its returning real projectile with a one-health test player.

Retired.variant_egg: Hidden save-compatibility ID; no longer earnable by design. Actual variant spawn eggs were exercised.
